name: BB 11 Clamp
desc: A table system in which individual solid-wood planks are held together by two adjustable flat-steel clamps instead of glue. It can be taken apart and set up by one person.
materials: Solid oak planks · Powder-coated flat steel frame (50 × 15 mm)
colors: Oiled natural or white-pigmented oak · Brushed or chainsaw finish · Black RAL 9005 frame
